title: IntegrationPlan
description: Produced by the Synthesizer per cycle. A structured description of all the writes the cycle wants to make to the project surface — slices, concepts, dependency-map edges, lessons, log entries. The orchestrator's integrator applies these section by section with semantic-merge discipline (idempotent edges, append-section semantics for concept extensions, dedupe-on-append for lessons). Designed to be the data structure the Phase-8 parallel-cycle integrator consumes; in the current serial model the integrator processes one plan per cycle. See `scaffolding/decisions/integration-plan-architecture.md` for design rationale.

slice_writes.description: Per-slice file writes. Each entry creates a new slice file or modifies an existing one. Prefer file_edits below for surgical edits to existing files.

path.description: Relative path under book/src/spec/slices/, e.g., 'gmres/step.md' or 'orthog.md'.

mode.description: `create` for new files (write content directly); `diff` for modifications to existing files (apply as unified diff). For surgical edits, prefer the top-level `file_edits` field which is more reliable than unified diffs.

content.description: For mode=create: the full file content.

diff.description: For mode=diff: a unified-diff string targeting the existing file.

title.description: Optional. For mode=create: the human-readable title to use in the SUMMARY.md auto-registration entry (e.g., 'GMRES' for the gmres slice). If omitted, the orchestrator derives a title from the slug. Added post meta-review #8 with SUMMARY.md auto-registration.

plan_kind.description: Optional. The kind of work this cycle does. Default `new_content`. Added meta-10 item 2 after cycle 36 produced a 0-substantive-writes pass that the Meta-Critic couldn't distinguish from a no-op. Tightened meta-13: retroactive_claims is RESERVED for cycles whose ONLY writes are rotation_claims/lessons/dep-map-edges (no slice creates or layer-section appends). Values: `new_content` = produces new slice/concept content on disk; `retroactive_claims` = emits rotation_claims for content that already exists on disk; `tightening` = revises an existing layer's content for internal correctness (no layer advancement); `back_correction` = restructures a lower layer in response to a push-back signal.

retroactive_against_cycle.description: Optional. When plan_kind=retroactive_claims, the cycle_id whose on-disk content is being claimed against. Added meta-14 item 3 to make legitimate backfills auditable from episodic alone (Meta-Critic can verify cycle N+k retroactive_claims actually point at on-disk content from cycle N). If the prose has accumulated over multiple cycles, name the most recent landing cycle.

slice_index_updates.description: Status-table row updates for `book/src/spec/index.md`. Added meta-10 item 1 (recurrence #2 of `file_edits` anchor mismatch on spec/index.md). The integrator locates the row by link-target anchor (`(./slices/<slug>.md)` or `(./slices/<slug>/index.md)`) and rewrites the layer/date/summary cells mechanically. The Synthesizer no longer needs to copy the row verbatim. Idempotent on (slice, layer, date, summary). Reserved for the in-table row update; `file_edits` on `spec/index.md` remains valid for non-row edits (headers, conventions).

slice.description: The slice slug; must match the path in `book/src/spec/slices/<slug>.md` or `<slug>/index.md`.

layer.description: The new highest layer text (e.g., 'L4', 'L2 (slice v0.3)').

date.description: Optional. The 'last touched' value. Defaults to today's UTC date if omitted.

summary.description: The status notes cell — a sentence or two describing the current slice state.

link_title.description: Optional. Override the link display text in the row. Defaults to the existing title or the slug.

section_appends.description: Append a new top-level section (`## Heading`) to the end of an existing file. The THIRD edit topology, alongside file-creation (slice_writes mode=create / concept_writes mode=create) and in-place modification (file_edits). Added 2026-05-24 meta-review #7 after diff-on-edit failures recurred in the section-append sub-mode. Each entry locates the file, verifies the exact heading line does NOT already exist (idempotency check), and inserts the new section at the end of the file. Use this for adding a new layer section (## L2, ## L3, ...) to an existing slice file, OR a new top-level section to any existing markdown file under book/src/ or scaffolding/.

path.description: Repo-relative path to an EXISTING markdown file. Safe-path policy as file_edits.

heading.description: The exact `## Heading` line (markdown heading-2 syntax). The integrator rejects if this line already exists in the file.

content.description: The section body, NOT including the heading line. May contain subsections (### ...) and prose freely. Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed.

file_edits.description: Find-replace edits to existing files (any path under book/src/, scaffolding/, or problems/). Symmetric to file_creates but for existing files. Each entry replaces the exact match of `old_string` with `new_string` in the named file. The orchestrator enforces exactly-one-match unless `replace_all` is true; an ambiguous old_string is rejected. This is the preferred edit channel — more reliable than unified diffs across LLM emissions. Added 2026-05-24 meta-review #6 after diff-on-edit failures recurred 6+ times.

path.description: Repo-relative path to an EXISTING file. Same safe-path policy as file_creates (book/src/, scaffolding/, problems/).

old_string.description: Exact text to replace. Must match the file content unambiguously (one occurrence) unless replace_all is true. Multi-line strings are supported.

replace_all.description: If true, replaces every occurrence. Default false (exactly-one-match required).

concept_writes.description: Concept-page writes. Each entry creates a new concept entry or extends an existing one with a new section. Multiple cycles touching the same concept page accumulate non-conflictingly when they target distinct sections.

name.description: Concept slug, matches the filename stem under book/src/concepts/.

mode.description: `create` for new concept files; `append-section` to add a new ## section to an existing concept page.

content.description: For mode=create: the full concept-page content. For mode=append-section: the section content INCLUDING the leading `## Heading` line.

kind.description: Optional, for mode=create. The category for the concepts/index.md table row. Defaults to `primitive` if omitted. Added meta-15.

dependency_map_edges.description: Edges to add to the concept dependency map (book/src/concepts/dependency-map.md). Idempotent: an edge that already exists is silently skipped. New nodes are added implicitly; new layer subsections need to be added via a separate slice_writes entry editing the file.

layer.description: Which layer subsection of the dependency map this edge belongs to.

from.description: The concept that depends on the to-concepts.

to.description: The concept(s) the from-concept depends on. May be empty for root concepts (just adds the node).

lessons.description: Lesson lines to append to lessons.md. Dedupe-on-append: if an identical line already exists in lessons.md, it's skipped. Date-prefix is added by the integrator.

log_synthesis.description: Summary of what the cycle produced. Either a plain string (one-line summary; legacy simple form) OR a structured object with a `summary` field plus optional `retroactive_claim_evidence` array (required when plan_kind=retroactive_claims OR when check #12 structural condition holds per meta-15). The integrator extracts `.summary` (or the whole string) for the LOG.md entry. Schema updated meta-17 after cycle 74 emitted the structured object form that the meta-11 prompt required but the original string-only schema rejected.

summary.description: One-line summary used as the LOG.md entry.

retroactive_claim_evidence.description: Per-claim quoted on-disk prose supporting each rotation_claim. Required when the plan emits rotation_claims against existing on-disk surface with no new layer prose in the same plan (Critic check #12).

on_disk_path.description: Repo-relative path to the file containing the quoted prose.

section.description: Optional section heading where the quote lives, e.g., '## L4 v0.4 — derived-view hoisting'.

quoted_lines.description: The actual quoted prose supporting the claim.

rotation_claims.description: Per-edge rotation_claims, validating against schemas/rotation_claim.json. The Synthesizer's primary output for verification purposes.
